messages:
mira: noticed a dip in DAU for APAC charts. quick scan shows ~9.8k events missing session_id in ap-south between 2026-03-08T02:15 and 02:40.
kevin: likely the sessionizer-v2 change rolled in that window. any deploy markers?
ici-bot: deploy-tracker: sessionizer-v2 deployed to ap-south at 2026-03-08T02:13.
ana: (typo) ana: I can run a small heuristic reattach: join on device_id + 20m window, tag with backfill_id=session-reattach-20260308. low risk and fast.
liam: what's the cost if we do a full recompute instead?
kevin: full recompute across shards would be ~2.5h at normal capacity and we'd need to schedule low-priority compute. heuristic has ~0.6% error in past runs, recompute ~0.02%.
mira: product wants accuracy but also needs timely numbers. proposal: run heuristic for affected tenants now, surface a banner on console, then schedule a low-priority recompute overnight if diffs >0.5%.
ana: parameters: tenants=[AP-TOP5], time_window=2026-03-08T02:15..02:40, heuristic_window=20m, concurrency=6, backfill_id=session-reattach-20260308, dedupe=true.
liam: route to replay-lane with cpu-quota=12% and priority-burst=8% for 30m. I'll add a routing rule.
ici-bot: backfill-scheduler: queued job id=job-20260308-0011 tag=session-reattach-20260308 owner=ana
ana: started job job-20260308-0011. shard=0 processed=430 assigned=2100 errs=0
kevin: console: add banner via flag console.replay_banner.session_attach with message "Partial recompute in progress for sessions (ETA ~45m). Numbers may change." enable for tenants AP-TOP5 only.
mira: monitoring: watch for consumer 429s and merge lag. throttle if 429s >3%.
ana: mid-run update: 3/8 shards done, processed=3700 reattached=3550 ambiguous=12.
liam: routing change applied. priority-burst will auto-disable after 30m.
ici-bot: backfill-runner: job-20260308-0011 completed processed=9834 reattached=9620 ambiguous=214 errs=0
mira: reconciliation shows charts back within expected ranges (delta <0.4%). scheduling recompute overnight as low-priority to reduce delta further.
kevin: follow-up: PR incoming to sessionizer schema guard to avoid writing empty session_id. will tag @mira for review.
mira: thanks everyone. I'll draft a short incident note for product and keep banner up until overnight recompute finishes.
